title: Three 9-foot skeletons vanish overnight
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Three 9-foot skeletons vanish overnight, about c. 1978-1981 at Church of Santa Anastasia, Sardinia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he laid them out, three bodies. They were at least 9 ft tall each. Next day, they were gone.

plain: A man named Tim Alberino tells podcast host Jesse Michels about something that, he was told, happened around 1978 to 1981 at the Church of Santa Anastasia on the Italian island of Sardinia. According to his account, a man laid out three skeletons there, each at least 9 feet tall, and the next day they were gone. It is told as evidence that giants once lived, and that the proof keeps vanishing.
